name: YOLOv3 detector
description: Finds objects and draws a box around each one. An early YOLO, kept for comparison with older work. Starts from a network already trained on everyday photographs, so it learns from few examples. Uses the Ultralytics package (AGPL-3.0 licence), installed the first time it is used; that needs internet.

choices.label: SPP - most accurate of the three

settings.label: Epochs
settings.help: How many times the model sees every training image.

settings.label: Image size (px)
settings.help: Patches are resized so their longer side is this long. Larger keeps small objects visible but needs more memory.

settings.label: Batch size
settings.help: Images per step. Lower it if the run fails with 'out of memory'.
